business_problem: When its specialized data platform, Eximpedia, started slowing down with the increasing volume of data it handled, Seair knew it needed to take action.
solution_summary: Seair Exim Solutions modernized its analytics estate on Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure AI Translator, moving from fragmented legacy tooling to a governed cloud data platform. Fabric and related services unify streaming, lake, warehouse, and BI capabilities so analysts and frontline teams can query fresher data without stitching together separate products. Power BI then serves dashboards, self-service exploration, and decision support to business users at scale. The move increased data ingestion speed by 90% and added more advanced search and visualization features, creating an even more robust solution that provides fast and reliable insights into the shipping industry.
